guv_f1.source: Salibi main Methods: FT-dependent activity and serial dilution of R3C; Figures 2 and 3
guv_f1.buffer: 50 mM EPPS pH 8.5; 20 mM MgCl2; interior 900 mM sucrose; exterior 900 mM glucose
guv_f1.FT: 5 minutes -80 C then 5 minutes room temperature; Figure 3 uses 3 FT per generation
guv_f1.retention_evidence: ~45% content loss per three FT inferred from Figure 2 gel fluorescence; not separately measured active-F1 survival
guv_f1.identity: horizontal exchange and supplied fresh substrate GUVs; no tracked parent-daughter pairs

bulk_s13.source: SI Figure 13/14, Methods S13, source workbook S13
bulk_s13.buffer: 50 mM EPPS pH 8.5; 20 mM MgCl2; 900 mM sucrose
bulk_s13.note: F1 and HyperA series are separate; F1 series has no HyperA. Cy5-A is G38A reporter; ligated Cy5-F1 is inactive. Only means/SD/n supplied for S13, not replicate numbers.

bulk_s12.source: SI Figure 12, Methods S12, workbook S12
bulk_s12.buffer: 50 mM EPPS pH 8.5; 20 mM MgCl2; sucrose not listed
bulk_s12.transfer: 1 uL previous reaction to 9 uL fresh substrate mixture; published half-generation coordinates retained literally
bulk_s12.use: qualitative functional regeneration vs inactive product challenge; not same-condition numeric holdout
bulk_s12.ambiguity: Before-incubation half-generation fluorescence yields in HyperA arms exceed simple 0.1 times previous endpoint; assay timing/background/normalization unresolved. Actual terminal zero entries D18/E18 retained as values without inventing missing-data status.

bulk_s15.source: SI Figure 15, Methods S15, workbook S15
bulk_s15.buffer: 50 mM EPPS pH 8.5; 20 mM MgCl2; no sucrose stated for bulk recipe
bulk_s15.ambiguity: Methods describes 10 uL initial reaction followed by another 10 uL buffer/GUV mixture; caption repeats nominal concentrations. Actual post-addition concentrations may be half listed; do not silently fit them as exact concentrations.
bulk_s15.use: membrane modulation challenge only; rates cannot be transplanted into encapsulated S13/serial-GUV fit

bulk_s18.source: SI Figure 18, Methods S18, workbook S18
bulk_s18.buffer: 50 mM EPPS pH 8.5; 20 mM MgCl2; sucrose not listed
bulk_s18.FT: 10 minutes -80 C then 10 minutes room temperature; optional subsequent 60 minutes 42 C

tracer_s9.interior: 900 mM sucrose; R3C salts not stated in caption
tracer_s9.protocol: Microscopy freeze-thaw protocol; distinct from PAGE PCR-tube cycling
tracer_s9.use: fluorescent tracer intensity distribution and ensemble intensity retention proxy; cannot identify active catalyst retention, activity loss, or parent-daughter inheritance

dye_s17.interior: 900 mM sucrose + 3 uM Alexa Fluor568 NHS ester
dye_s17.use: pre/post GUV size distributions are structural fragmentation evidence, not measured molecule transfer or paired lineages
